citizen_dispute.desc: Two citizens argue over a parking space, a dog, or an old grudge.

crowd_gathering.desc: A busker or a preacher draws a ring of onlookers.

traffic_collision.desc: Two traffic vehicles collide; drivers argue; traffic snarls.

police_sweep.desc: CCPD checkpoint sweep; pedestrians detour; wanted players get attention.

mugging.desc: A thug corners a pedestrian. Intervene, or watch, or join.

street_fight.desc: Two drunks settle it with hands. A crowd forms and takes sides.

steam_vent.desc: A street vent blows; steam curls between the towers.

fire_barrel.desc: Workers cluster around a drum fire, trading gossip.

gang_shakedown.desc: Julian's collectors lean on a shopkeeper for the envelope.

stray_cat.desc: A dock cat leads someone somewhere it wants to be fed.

radio_car.desc: A Halcyon PR van cruises, broadcasting redevelopment promises.

ambulance.desc: Sirens cross the district; traffic yields badly.

turf_war.desc: Syndicate muscle and Halcyon contractors collide over a crate nobody should have moved.
